title: adaf xise
intro: fidin baaxooxal, caylale numtin amoh gexo qimmiseh, mango reeda kee maqnisso yeceeh. Tama rooci baxaabaxsale ayyuntat garayeeh, baxsale taqabitte kataaseeh, ken abtoota kee qilmih addat aydaadu kee imaanal qimmoh addah asta cabak, inkih ken qanxaffeh raceena kinnim tamixxige.
clues: Anu kullimih amol reeda kee maqnisso yomcowweeh, gita kataate.
Yi safar ayro cultah tan arac yoo beeh, sinam elle geekkel.
Anu namma qaleh fanat yan yab cede waa ayyuntat ongoorowe.
Anu adaf xisam essereh suge, cankâ fayxih hinnay, finqah yan caylak kalaluh.
Anu ta giffole gidaar xisnuh maqar Yallak yemeetem kee xagni uddur fan soolelem qaddoyseh.
Yi migaq, mango uddur 'Namma Gaysa le tiya' axcuk maqnisan, ardi bagul geytimam hinnay namma baxsale wakti kinnim tamixxige.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
